newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms say not close to Airbus jet deal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms say not close to Airbus jet deal.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Group and Korean Air Lines Co on Monday denied a newspaper report that Airbus Industrie was close to signing U.S. Lockheed Martin and a Korean company as partners to develop 550-seat jet.

Britain's Observer said on Sunday European aircraft consortium Airbus hoped to close a deal within a month with Lockheed and either Korean Air Lines or Samsung for the A3XX project, estimated to cost $8.0 billion.
Samsung and Korean Air officials said they were interested in the deal but no development has been made.
"It's an exaggerated report," said a senior official at Korean Air. "We are interested in the deal but no serious talks have begun."
A Samsung Group spokesman said: "We have attended Airbus's presentation and we've shown our interest. But no development has been made."
The A3XX is a vital product for Airbus as it aims to break Boeing Co 's monopoly of the large capacity airline market.
